provenance.notice: Independent portfolio demonstrator. Entirely synthetic data: the organisation 'Orion Systems Engineering', all demands, roles, figures and scenarios are fictional. Not affiliated with any real organisation; never deployed in production.
provenance.method: Exported from the public repository's synthetic CSV files through the repository's own Python modules, then reduced to the fields this demo needs. Requester site and department columns, role names and free-text business cases are omitted.
provenance.neutralised: Titles and site labels neutralised for this site; all numeric and categorical fields unchanged from the repository's synthetic dataset.
provenance.fixtureNote: Fixture 'all' equals the KPI values in the repository's committed reports/report_facts.json. The repository defines KPIs for the full set only; subset fixtures were produced during the audit by running the repository's kpis.compute on the filtered demand, event and decision rows while finance, capacity and gate results stayed at portfolio level.

definitions.total_demands: All registered records with a request date on or before the cutoff.
definitions.open_demands: Records whose status is not Complete, Rejected or Routed Out.
definitions.by_status: Count of records per current lifecycle status (demands.csv).
definitions.open_by_priority: Open demands per priority band derived from the weighted score.
definitions.open_by_team: Open demands per responsible delivery team.
definitions.intake_by_month: Records per month of request date.
definitions.overdue_open: Open demands whose required-by date is before the cutoff.
definitions.blocked_open: Open demands flagged as blocked with a recorded reason.
definitions.stale_open: Open, not deferred, and no status event for 14 days or more.
definitions.unassigned_open: Open demands without an assigned owner.
definitions.completeness_pct: Demands (excluding routed-out records) with every mandatory intake field filled / all such demands.
definitions.deferred_review_due_30d: Deferred demands with a next review date within 30 days of the cutoff.
definitions.median_triage_business_days: Median working days from submission to the first Triaged event (status history); demands never triaged are excluded.
definitions.median_lead_time_days: Median calendar days from submission to completion for completed demands.
definitions.throughput_by_month: Completed demands per month of the Complete event.
definitions.on_time_delivery_pct: Completed demands finished on or before the required-by date / completed demands.
definitions.stage_ageing_median_days: Median days open demands have spent in their current status (from the latest matching status event).
definitions.stage_ageing_days: Days in current status per open demand.
definitions.decision_outcomes: Recorded decisions on or before the cutoff (decisions.csv).
definitions.routed_out: Records routed out of the demand pipeline (incidents, standard service requests).
definitions.high_priority_not_approvable: Undecided or deferred demands in band High or Highest that fail at least one gate today.
